Serial Killer Robert Joe Adams Freed on Parole in Australia

Robert Joe Adams, convicted of the "Snowtown" murders, has been released on parole in Australia. The details of his release and the specific date were not provided in the coverage. Separately, a retiring grape grower in the Riverland region of Australia expressed that industry support has arrived too late.
